article.title: An econometrician on the SEIRD epidemiological model for Covid-19
article.excerpt: There is a new paper by Ivan Korolev : This paper studies the SEIRD epidemic model for COVID-19. First, I show that the model is poorly identified from the observed number of deaths and confirmed cases.
